t: You're on Wellington Street, in Covent Garden. It connects Bow Street, Russell Street, Tavistock Street, Exeter Street, the Strand and Lancaster Place. The street was first established in 1834, and it takes its name from Arthur Wellesley, the first Duke of Wellington. He was a Field Marshal and statesman who served as Prime Minister and as Commander-in-Chief of the Forces, and he was one of the leading figures in British politics at the time.
